title: fix(platform-objects): decide the report panel's dataset-binding and filter en-echoes per leaf, and give report.sections.* a carrier
body:
Part of #19403 — round 9. The `report.*` family: 6 `en` leaves x 3 locales = **18 locale-leaves**, decided one at a time.

Clause-②: no

## ⭐⭐ Read this before the numbers: the zero is a property of the PREDICATE, not of the surface

`report.*` was the **last** family echoing in all three locales. With it decided, this card's headline reading — `.label` keys echoing in **all three** locales — is **0** across the whole metadata-form catalog.

⛔ **The surface is not clean and this card is not finished.** Re-derived on this branch's own base:

| population | `en` leaves | locale-leaves | visible to the all-three predicate? |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `report.*` — decided here | 6 | 18 | ✅ yes, and it was the last |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.*` | **32** (16 `label` + 16 `helpText`) | **64** | ⛔ **NO — it reads ZERO** |
| `email_template.fields.variables.helpText` | 1 | 2 | ⛔ no |

⇒ **64 locale-leaves still ship English to a `ja-JP` or an `es-ES` author** and the headline predicate cannot see one of them, because `zh-CN` authored all 32. The round-10 handover number **32 / 64 still holds**, re-measured here: `ja-JP` 32 of 32 echoing, `es-ES` 32 of 32, `zh-CN` 0 of 32.

⭐ That claim is not left as prose. `the headline predicate is BLIND to a panel one locale reads in English` in the new ledger proves it on a **synthetic** catalog, so it holds independently of what the tree contains on any day: a population every locale but one has authored returns **0** from the all-three predicate and **non-zero** from the per-locale one, in the same run.

⭐ And `report.sections.*` is the population the card's own body flags as covered by nothing — 「⚠️ A population NOTHING covers … **承接者:无**」. This round gives it a carrier: the ledger's walk reaches **8 section leaves**, asserted by count and by name.

## What was decided, and why each way

| leaf | `en` | verdict | the evidence the row rests on |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `sections.dataset_binding.label` | Dataset binding | translate x3 | both halves have authored twins on this panel: `fields.dataset.label` and `fields.dataset.helpText` |
| `sections.dataset_binding.description` | The semantic-layer dataset … | translate x3 | the schema was read first; every term copied from `dataset.description` and `dataset.sections.{measures,dimensions}.label`; the verb copied from `fields.dataset.helpText` |
| `fields.drilldown.label` | Drilldown | translate x3 | ⛔ **no authored twin for "drill" in either catalog — the row says so** rather than leaning on one |
| `fields.drilldown.helpText` | Click an aggregated row/cell … | translate x3 | every term has a twin except "cell", which is named as having none |
| `fields.runtimeFilter.label` | Runtime Filter | translate x3 | ⭐⭐ **copied byte for byte from an authored twin** |
| `fields.runtimeFilter.helpText` | Render-time scope filter, ANDed … | translate x3 | `dataset.fields.filter.helpText` carries the same sentence pattern, already authored |

The words: 数据集绑定 · データセットのバインド · Vinculación del conjunto de datos — 下钻 · ドリルダウン · Desglose — 运行时筛选 · 実行時フィルター · Filtro en tiempo de ejecución.

### ⭐⭐ One schema key, one rendering — this round found an exact twin

`report.fields['blocks.runtimeFilter']` is the **same schema key** one repeater level down. `reportForm` **declares** `label: 'Runtime Filter'` there and declares **none** at the top level, and a translator had already authored 运行时筛选 / 実行時フィルター / Filtro en tiempo de ejecución for that position while leaving this one a byte copy. Same English string, same schema key, one position authored by a hand and the other manufactured by `humanizeFieldPath`.

⇒ the top-level position is now **that word**, and the copy is asserted, so the two can only move together. Ablation 2 below reddens it.

### ⚠️⚠️ The phantom-translation trap, in its sharpest form: the shortcut does not exist here

`reportForm` declares no label on `drilldown` and none on `runtimeFilter` (asserted), so both English strings are the extractor's humanize — round 8's `Api Enabled` shape. ⭐ But here the humanize lands on **correct English**: `drilldown` humanizes to exactly `Drilldown` and `runtimeFilter` to exactly `Runtime Filter`, which the ledger asserts. Round 8's escape hatch — touch up the English, satisfy the echo predicate in every locale, translate nothing — is therefore **unavailable**, and the only byte change that clears the predicate is a real translation. That is asserted, not narrated.

### ⚠️ The one deliberate departure from a literal rendering, and why

#19355 rendered this panel's `values` box with the **dataset's** word in all three locales — 度量 / メジャー / Medidas all mean "measures". So a literal "Values are the dataset's measures" reads as an identity in every translated locale and carries information only in English. The clause is rendered as the **attribution** it actually makes ("come from this dataset's measures and dimensions"), with the verb copied from this panel's own `fields.dataset.helpText` rather than chosen: 来自 / から取得 / provienen de. ⛔ What was refused: re-wording `fields.values.label` to restore the English contrast — a landed decision of this card that three other leaves now depend on.

### The semantic layer, read AT THE SCHEMA before a word was rendered

Every claim `sections.dataset_binding.description` makes is pinned against the live schema:

- `DatasetSchema` declares `dimensions` (groupable axes) and `measures` (aggregatable values) and **refuses** `values` / `rows` / `columns` with `unrecognized_keys`.
- `ReportSchema` does the reverse: declares `values` / `rows`, refuses `measures` / `dimensions`.
- ⭐ **the mapping the prose states is the schema's own** — the joined-block alias table answers `measures` with `values` and `dimensions` with `rows`, in its rejection message, and the `order` refinement names both halves in one live sentence.
- `drilldown` is a **boolean** defaulting to `true` (ADR-0021 D2), so the helpText describes a toggle; a config object there is refused.
- class-(c) answered at the schema: a rendered word can land in neither key, as a **value** (`invalid_type`) or as a **key** (`unrecognized_keys`).

## ⚠️ A defect in round 8's ledger, repaired in the block this round had to edit anyway

`object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts` bounded its two-locale control with `expect(twoLocale.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(deferred.length)` — and `twoLocale` is `deferred.filter(…)`, a subset bounded by the set it came out of. **True for every tree**: a tautology inside that round's headline control.

Repaired **against the recorded literal**, the spelling the same file already uses 105 lines up, with two legs the old one could not have:

- **it can say NO** — a 33rd two-locale echo breaks the bound, and the **old** spelling is run on the same input beside it and still reads `true`: the defect executed rather than described.
- **shrink-only** — `withinRecorded(0)` is `true`, so round 10 emptying the deferral leaves the file green.

The two-locale control stays **visible** rather than excluded, and the deferral's owner is re-pointed from "round 9" to "round 10" (round 9's family was `report.*`).

## ⚠️ Five landed assertions this diff made false — repaired in place and declared

This round decided the **last** metadata-form leaf `zh-CN` still read in English, so the `metadataForms.` slice of its provenance companion is now **empty**. Five landed ledgers (rounds 2–6) drew their positive dark control out of exactly that slice, so five controls turned into `undefined` — a control seeded from the population this card **shrinks** expires by design, the shape round 7's provenance floor had.

Re-seeded off the **whole** table: the sibling `objects.` slice is a population this card does not touch, so the draw cannot empty. Every claim in those blocks is unchanged. ⛔ Nothing was lowered and nothing was deleted.

## The measurements — all re-taken on this branch's own base, base `0e658fbe9` → head `1f0e71046`

| reading | base | head |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `en` string leaves / `.label` leaves | 893 / 538 | 893 / 538 |
| ⭐ **the headline** — `.label` keys echoing in ALL THREE | **3** (9 leaves) | **0** (0 leaves) |
| ⭐ **POSITIVE CONTROL, moving the other way** — labels genuinely translated | 535 · 519 · 519 | **538 · 522 · 522** |
| per-locale `.label` echoes (`zh-CN` · `ja-JP` · `es-ES`) | 3 · 19 · 19 | 0 · 16 · 16 |
| decidable remainder — **every** string leaf echoing in at least one locale | **39** | **33** |

⭐ The two move by different amounts and the reason is worth stating rather than smoothing: this round decides **3 labels and 3 non-labels**, so the headline drops by 3 while the real remainder drops by 6. State which count you mean.

### Add and remove no keys

Regenerated with **`pnpm i18n:extract`**, ⛔ never by hand. Full flattened key sets, base vs head, all four bundles:

```
en:    893 -> 893 · added 0 · removed 0 · values changed 0
zh-CN: 893 -> 893 · added 0 · removed 0 · values changed 6
ja-JP: 893 -> 893 · added 0 · removed 0 · values changed 6
es-ES: 893 -> 893 · added 0 · removed 0 · values changed 6
NEGATIVE CONTROL, same comparator: +1 key => added 1 removed 0 · -1 key => added 0 removed 1
```

### Second witness — the `metadataForms.`-prefixed companions

A prefix the bundles themselves do not carry, so a misspelt key shape reads 0 for everything and looks clean:

```
zh-CN.source-hashes: 368 -> 362 · dropped 6 · added 0 · SET EQUALITY with the 6 decided leaves: true
ja-JP.source-hashes: 422 -> 416 · dropped 6 · added 0 · SET EQUALITY: true
es-ES.source-hashes: 431 -> 425 · dropped 6 · added 0 · SET EQUALITY: true
PERTURBED EXPECTATION, one member swapped, every locale: false
metadataForms.report.* rows remaining at head, every locale: 0
```

### The population, derived from `reportForm`

45 `en` string leaves — **8 section** + **37 field** — with the form and the catalog asserted equal in **both** directions, so a field added to the form tomorrow joins without anybody editing a list. Controls:

- **OUTWARD, and it is a LIVE echo**: the same walker handed `objectForm` reaches all **32** `lifecycle` leaves, so the exclusion is this population's choice and not the walker's incapacity. They are OUT, asserted on the leaf ids. `datasetForm` (37 leaves, 0 echoing) is excluded too, asserted rather than trusted precisely because a wrong sweep of it would **not** go red.
- **INWARD, AUTHORED**: **39 of the population's own 45** leaves come back NON-echoing in all three locales, in the same walk — including the twin `blocks.runtimeFilter`.
- **DARK**: fed the `en` catalog, the same walk flags all 45 and the echo predicate flags all 6 rows.

## Ablations — 6 runs, 13 reds, 12 distinct assertions, 2 files

Each mutation proved on disk by **anchor count + blob hash**; each restore proved by **blob hash == HEAD** and an **empty `git diff HEAD`**, with a whole-tree `git status --porcelain` read after every run.

| # | mutation | proof it landed | reds |
|--:|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | re-fill `zh-CN report.fields.drilldown.label` with its `en` | anchor 1→0, blob `92a1511fafb4`→`8f02884c465d` | **5** — verdict, phantom, ratchet, headline-zero, provenance lookup |
| 2 | reword the authored twin `blocks.runtimeFilter` in `zh-CN` | anchor 1→0, blob `92a1511fafb4`→`99229a45330a` | 1 — one schema key, one rendering |
| 3 | reword the `en` source of `drilldown.helpText` | anchor 1→0, blob `b8a246889186`→`4b7fcf861bc3` | 2 — the `en` pin, the echo predicate's dark leg |
| 4 | `reportForm` declares `label: 'Drill Down'` on `drilldown` | anchor 1→0, blob `c4239302f40c`→`e5344fa083de`; **dist preflight: marker present in 6 built files** | 2 — the third leg, the phantom assertion |
| 5 | rename the block alias key `measures` → `measuresAblated` | anchor 1→0, blob `fe9d289f63ba`→`bdc47403dab6`; **dist preflight: marker present in 18 built files** | 2 — the alias mapping, the asymmetry reading |
| 6 | `RECORDED_DEFERRAL` 32 → 31 in round 8's repaired block | anchor 1→0, blob `947c80ba10b4`→`8f78a80f776b` | 1 — the repaired bound, on the LIVE tree |

⚠️ **Two disclosures, because the discipline is to re-author the mutation and never re-run until something lands:**

1. Ablation 5 was authored **three** times. The first two runs **never reached vitest** and their colour is not a reading: attempt 1 used `--delete` with an `--absent` dist marker, which the preflight correctly read as a restore leg and refused on a tree dirty by construction; attempt 2 named the marker in the source's **single-quoted** spelling while `dist` carries the **double-quoted** one, so no dirty path carried it and the preflight again read the run as a restore leg. The third authoring uses a marker that appears in **both** spellings and the run measured.
2. Ablation 4's mutation reached `dist`, so the restore leg is two-part: the source restore is proved by blob-vs-HEAD, and `packages/spec` was **rebuilt** afterwards with `ablation-dist-preflight … --absent` confirming `marker absent from all 216 built files`. Same for ablation 5. ⛔ Neither marker pre-existed in `dist`.

## Gates, tests, changeset

- **60 / 60 derived gates green, 0 NOT MEASURED.** Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the real change set (14 paths, 1263 changed lines, under the 5000 human-merge threshold), re-derived after the last commit with an identical list. Exit codes captured **before** any pipe.
- **Two exit-3s, both discharged by building the closure the gate named**, not by reading them as passes: `check:i18n` (the CLI plus the 9 packages it extracts — the gate prints that closure as one command) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (the whole workspace). Both green afterwards; `check:i18n` reports all **9** packages in sync.
- ⚠️ A first pass of the gate sweep was **discarded, not reported**: the runner script relied on the caller's working directory and measured the **shared checkout** instead of this worktree. Every reading above comes from the re-run inside the worktree.
- **Tests**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` — **848 passed / 848, 53 files**. The new ledger is 35 of them; round 8's is 43.
- **Typecheck**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` green, test layer included.
- **Lint**: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) run **whole** on the final tree — exit 0. No narrowing was needed, so none is claimed.
- **Changeset `patch`**, and `skip-changeset` would be measurably wrong. Probed the package's own `files[]` set with every spelling **built from the character itself**: the rendered strings ship in **6** files each. ⭐ The same set spells `U+00F3` as an UPPER-CASE `\xNN` escape and `U+4E0B` as an UPPER-CASE `\uXXXX` one — **two spellings in one build**, so a probe typed as one escape form reads a false zero on the other, which is exactly what the es strings did until the probe was rebuilt from the characters. A **raw un-escaped negative control** (a character this round never wrote) reads **0** in all three spellings, so a zero means "absent" rather than "the scanner finds nothing".
- **Merge**: `git fetch origin main` immediately before the final push — `origin/main` is still `0e658fbe9`, byte-identical to this branch's base, confirmed independently with `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main`. `git merge origin/main` reports **Already up to date**, so no two-legged proof is owed.
- **Governed surfaces**: 0 of 14 paths. Everything is under `packages/platform-objects/` or `.changeset/`.

## Acceptance notes

Observations recorded here rather than filed, per this round's scope.

- ⚠️ **`ReportSchema`'s alias table omits the two keys the block's carries** — `measures` → `values` and `dimensions` → `rows` live on `JoinedReportBlockSchema` and **not** on the top-level report, so an author who writes `measures:` on a plain report gets a bare `unrecognized_keys` with no suggestion while the identical key one level down gets the rename. Reachable today; producer named: `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`. The panel's own prose actively invites the author to type that word. Asserted in the ledger as a **reading**, ⛔ not repaired — a spec-side edit outside this round's file surface, and it discharges no row above.
- **`object.fields.lifecycle.*`** — 32 `en` leaves, 64 locale-leaves, echoing in `ja-JP` and `es-ES` only. Round 10's pre-declared scope; carried, re-measured, ⛔ not touched.
- **`email_template.fields.variables.helpText`** — a third two-locale echo, still live. Round 8 gave it a carrier of "this card, round 9+"; this round's file surface was `report.*` only, so it rides round 10 or a later one.
- **The `*.objects.generated.ts` echo population is unchanged and far larger** — re-measured on this base: **362** (`zh-CN`) · **383** (`ja-JP`) · **392** (`es-ES`) echoing against a working control of **1203** · **1182** · **1173** translated, over 1565 `en` leaves. `objects.sys_session.fields.last_activity_at.label` still reads `"Last Activity At"` in all three. No carrier.
- **The generated-bundle merge hazard is still live** — `git check-attr merge` reads `unspecified` on the `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` and `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles, against a control of `os-regen` on `packages/spec/spec-changes.json`. The card's body already rules that routing those paths is an `AGENTS.md` decision and not this card's. Re-measured, ⛔ not acted on.
- **The word-boundary token guard under-reaches on kana, and the ledger asserts its own limit** rather than leaving it implicit: キャンセル contains セル, which a substring guard calls a hit and this predicate calls a miss — and it calls a miss even where セル really does stand as a word. Only the Latin `AND` token is guarded with it.
